armour:helmet_shell: Both runs: the same teal ramp and teal outline as now, but the smooth plates became small overlapping scales (the 'scales sewn on a backing' I asked for), which read as busy noise at 2x. Run 2 is a little darker and adds a clearer eye slit; both are 2 px narrower than now.
armour:chest_shell: Both runs: scale pattern instead of today's smooth plate; same palette, outline and light. Run 2 turns the scales into a diagonal lattice and spreads the shoulders wider; fill about the same as now.
armour:leg_shell: Both runs: one joined pair of trousers in scales instead of today's two separate greaves; same palette. Run 2 is a little cleaner and bigger at the knees.
armour:boot_shell: Run 1 drew boots seen from the side (the guide's lesson), smaller than now. Run 2 went back to a front-view pair, closer to the 03 sheet and to today's boots, but still in scales.
armour:diamond_helmet: Both close the gap to the approved 11-04 helmet: teal crystal dome, brown straps, warm visor trim. Run 1's visor is pale silver, run 2's is darker and busier. Neither keeps 11-04's big orange-brown face plate and its large central gem; both read smaller.
armour:diamond_chestplate: Both runs: the 11-04 build (crystal plates, brown belt, cream collar), but in small scales instead of 11-04's big faceted plates, so less contrast. Run 2 matches 11-04's broad shoulders better.
armour:diamond_leggings: Both runs: belt and buckle as 11-04, legs in scales, nearly the same silhouette. Run 2 drops some of the brown between the plates; run 1 is the closer match to 11-04.
armour:diamond_boots: Run 1: side-view boots with lots of brown leather, the furthest from 11-04. Run 2: a front pair with brown cuffs and toes, much closer to 11-04's boots and the set row. Both smaller than 11-04.
tools:part_long_blade: Both runs: a clean diamond blade, the same teal ramp, bevel and outline as the approved blade on the tool (today's loose part icon is a grey generic). Nearly identical between runs.
tools:part_short_blade: Run 1 drew a slim leaf; run 2 a broad faceted short blade that reads better and is bigger. Same palette and outline as the approved diamond.
tools:part_axe_head: Both runs: a diamond felling head with an eye, matching the approved head's palette. Run 2's is more faceted and blockier, run 1's closer to the flared 11-04 shape.
tools:part_pick_head: Both: a teal crescent with an eye, shaped like the approved pick head; run 2's is longer and swept like the 11-04 drawing. Very close.
tools:part_shovel_blade: Both runs: a rounded faceted blade with a socket, larger than the head on today's tool. Nearly identical between runs.
tools:part_hoe_blade: Run 1: a tiny flat chip (fill 7%), unreadable at 2x. Run 2: bigger and reads as a blade with a neck, still smaller than the approved hoe head. Both lack today's L-shaped hoe head.
tools:part_spear_point: Both: a small leaf point in diamond, readable but small (9-10% fill). Little difference between runs.
tools:diamond_sword: Both runs land very close to today's composed sword and the 11-04 sword: same blade, bevel and diagonal. The hilt changes: oak grip and iron guard as asked, where today's tool has a lighter iron map and 11-04 had gold.
tools:diamond_pickaxe: Both: very close to today's composed pickaxe (same crescent, same diagonal). The oak haft is a brighter, plainer orange than the game's oak ramp, and there's a small iron collar. Run 1 needed 3 tries (a vertical edge); run 2 passed at once.
tools:diamond_axe: Both: the axe the guide asks for, head crosswise at the top, edge along the diagonal. Run 2's head is a larger triangular blade; run 1's is closer to today's head. Haft brighter orange than today's.
tools:diamond_shovel: Both: a diamond spade on an oak haft, like today's but with a rounder, larger blade. Nearly the same between runs.
tools:diamond_hoe: Run 1 failed the design: a thin point like a spear, no blade across the haft. Run 2 drew a real hoe blade across the top, close to today's and 11-04's, slightly blockier.
tools:diamond_spear: Both: a long oak shaft with a diamond leaf point (today shows the plain spear icon, no diamond look yet). Run 2's point is a little bigger and more faceted.
food:bread: Both: a near-copy of today's loaf (same crust, crumb end, scored top). Run 2 is bigger, filling the slot like today's.
food:apple: Both: today's apple again (glossy red, stem and leaf). Run 1 is smaller; run 2 matches today's size.
food:cooked_beef: Both: duller and browner than today's steak, which has a bright orange rim; grill marks kept. Run 2 is darker still and bigger.
food:beef: Both: the same raw steak with marbling and fat rim as today. Run 2 is the closer match in size and fat edge.
food:trout: Both: today's trout again (olive back, pink stripe, pale belly). Run 1 pinker, run 2 a little smaller and duller.
food:stew: Both: a wooden bowl with meat stew and a spoon, like today's; less orange in the bowl, more chunks. Run 2 needed 2 tries.
food:egg: Both: smaller than today's egg (I asked for the 60-70% size of a chicken's egg from the size lesson) and warmer peach than today's pale cream.
food:carrot: Both: today's carrot almost pixel for pixel in look; run 2 is a touch larger and greener in the leaves.
blocks:stone: Run 1: smaller, rounder cobbles with darker crevices, more like cobblestone than today's soft slabs. Run 2 (01 sheet): lighter and closer to today's value, slabs a little bigger, still more outlined than today's.
blocks:diamond_ore: Run 1: three big round gems, bolder than today. Run 2 (03 sheet): faceted shards in sockets, close to today's ore, with a darker socket rim.
blocks:log_oak: Run 1: warmer orange bark with wavy grooves, a visible repeat. Run 2 (04 sheet): finer, busier reddish-brown bark with shallow grooves; today's has deeper, wider vertical ridges.
blocks:leaves_oak: Both greyscale as asked, but darker than today's (mean grey 140 and 131 against 174), so the tint comes out a deep green; leaves smaller and noisier, about the same gaps (17-19% clear).
armour:verdict: Both runs keep our palette, outline and light, but my 'scales sewn on a backing' prompt turned the plates into fine scales that read as noise at 2x. The 03 sheet (run 2) helped the boots and shoulders match 11-04. Neither run keeps 11-04's big faceted plates: to match it, ask for 3-5 large crystal plates per piece, not scales.
tools:verdict: Built tools: both runs reproduce today's look closely (sword and pickaxe almost the same); the haft comes out a brighter orange than the game's oak ramp. Run 2 fixed run 1's broken hoe and drew bigger, clearer parts. Loose parts are new (today's are grey generics): both runs give clean diamond parts that match the drawn heads.
food:verdict: Food reproduces today's set almost exactly in both runs (bread, apple, raw beef, carrot); the only drift is cooked beef browner and duller, and the egg smaller and warmer. Run 2 (07 + 16 sheets) matches today's sizes better than run 1.
blocks:verdict: Run 2's sheets help the ore and stone match today's tiles; the log goes noisier with them, and both runs make leaves darker and finer than today's.
